endpoint.pool: exact requested pool; published URL aliases retained; no v1 fallback

source_operation.description: Create new registries integration in provided cluster

400.description: Invalid request body or path parameters. Fix the request body and path parameters and try again.

request.private_serializer: mks/wire.go requestBody; protected inputs revealed only to resource request, safe formatting stays redacted
request.scope: immutable account/project/region/pool; create pool must equal scope.pool
request.path: wire path after /v2; all IDs escaped as one segment; parent refs required for nodegroups/nodes/tasks
request.fields: all schema properties preserve optional absence, explicit false/zero/empty arrays/maps; no provider default inserted
request.user_data: caller-provided base64 text in ProtectedValue; validated and forwarded unchanged, never encoded a second time
request.additional_software: ProtectedJSON source object; explicitly supplied even though deprecated/required by source schema
request.validation: required/nested fields before credential I/O; cluster name and declared cluster_type; taint effect and dedicated currency enums

response.mapping: all response fields, exact Integer/Number, UTC known timestamps; schemaless data and payload strings protected; provider ref ignored
response.identity: response id/project/pool/parent conflicts rejected before receipt ref retention; exact request identity preserved; trustworthy known ID retained on other accepted decode failure
response.nodegroup_create: 204 returns no new nodegroup IDs or task IDs. Only known parent cluster ref retained; no list diff/adoption
response.hierarchy: nodegroup.parent=cluster; node.parent=nodegroup; task.parent=cluster; response parent IDs verified; nested node refs retained

errors.malformed_successful_mutation: accepted receipt + protocol_error with trustworthy refs
errors.message: safe SDK errors; provider error text not diagnostics

retry: bounded safe reads; mutation never replayed

wait.active: ACTIVE succeeds; ERROR fails; other documented cluster/nodegroup states pending; new states state_unknown
wait.task_done: DONE succeeds; ERROR/CANCELED fail; IN_QUEUE/IN_PROGRESS pending
wait.deleted: exact Get 404; unavailable endpoint or 403 cannot confirm deletion
wait.node_deleted: Node has no status property. Existing Get is pending with empty ProviderState; 404 confirms requested node absent
wait.receipt_restriction: receipt-bound Wait allows only these declared goals; parent readiness is not completion of groups created without IDs

recovery.kind: resource observation for a known exact ref; indeterminate, never authorship proof; no selecting latest task or newly appeared resource
recovery.correlation: provider_operation_ref absent unless documented causal ID returned; this API source does not return such task IDs in mutations
